name: Game-state conditions and experience / poison counts read the source's controller, not the open tab's
notes: Conditions in the parser (your turn, city's blessing, no / N or more cards in hand, life totals) read Battlefield.gameState, the player whose tab is open; experience and poison counts too. _gsOfController (cards-parser.js) reads the source's controller; _gsOfNamedPlayers reads 'an opponent' / 'a player' / 'each player' for hand conditions; _countPlayerCounters (engine-compute.js) reads 'you have', 'your opponents have', 'its controller has'. Player 1's tab is open: not their turn, 7 cards, 20 life, 2 poison. Player 2: their turn, the city's blessing, no cards in hand, 30 life, 3 experience, 5 poison. Player 2's Wildwood Geist 5/5, Dusk Charger 5/5, Gathan Raiders 5/5, Serra Ascendant 6/6, Kalemne 6/6, Akki Underling (seven or more cards) 2/1. Player 1's Mycosynth Fiend (poison your opponents have) 7/7, Guul Draz Specter (an opponent has no cards in hand) 5/5. Memory: project_game_state_conditions_by_controller_2026-10-14.
